name: Merrimack County, NH
findings: Merrimack County has 730 nonprofit organizations. 271 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 231 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Merrimack County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
